children: BMO clients can get more with Blue Rewards through new, enhanced debit earning opportunities and a seamless digital experience that makes it easier to earn and save on everyday spending.
Earn 2x Blue Points at Instacart, Dollarama and participating MTY Group restaurants when eligible offers are activated.
Seamless access to Blue Rewards through integrated BMO Mobile Banking app and Online Banking.

TORONTO, Sept. 8, 2026 /CNW/ -- BMO today announced new Blue Rewards benefits that make it easier than ever for BMO personal banking clients to earn Blue Points, save on everyday spending and make real financial progress. With expanded debit rewards available across most BMO chequing accounts, enhanced partner offers and seamless integration into BMO's Mobile Banking app and Online Banking, more clients now have the flexibility and convenience to earn rewards through everyday purchases and banking activities.

"We are making Blue Rewards more rewarding, convenient and relevant to how BMO clients bank every day," said Jennifer Hawkins, President, Blue Rewards. "Whether they are buying groceries, filling up at the pump, ordering dinner or shopping with participating partners, our clients have more opportunities to earn rewards and more ways to earn and access rewards through the digital experiences they use most. By helping clients get more value from everyday spending, we are helping them make real financial progress."
Earn Points on Everyday Spending

Clients with most BMO chequing accounts can now earn Points on qualifying debit purchases, giving more BMO clients the opportunity to earn rewards on everyday spending. Clients can earn 1 Point for every $2 spent on eligible grocery, wholesale, gas and EV charging purchases.1
More Ways to Earn Through Exclusive Partner Offers
BMO chequing account and credit card clients can unlock additional ways to earn through enhanced partner offers and rewards. When eligible offers are activated, clients can earn 2x Points at:
Instacart
Dollarama
Participating MTY Group restaurants, including Jugo Juice, Manchu Wok, Mr. Sub, Mucho Burrito, Pizza Delight, TacoTime, Sushi Shop and Thai Express
Clients will also gain access to a growing range of offers, rewards and partner benefits through Blue Rewards.
Seamless Digital Experience

BMO clients can seamlessly access Blue Rewards through BMO's Mobile Banking app and Online Banking, making it easier for clients to discover offers, track rewards and access benefits all in one place. The integrated experience allows BMO clients to:
Enroll in Blue Rewards directly through BMO Mobile Banking app and Online Banking
Link an existing Blue Rewards member number to their BMO profile
View personalized offers and earning opportunities
Access rewards balances, transactions and available perks in one place
Seamlessly access Blue Rewards redemption experiences through secure single sign-on functionality

With Blue Rewards, BMO clients get more from their everyday banking through additional earning opportunities, partner benefits and easy access to rewards through an integrated digital experience. The enhanced experience gives clients more flexibility to earn, track and redeem Points while getting greater value from everyday spending.

About BMO Financial Group

BMO Financial Group is the eighth largest bank in North America by assets, with total assets of $1.5 trillion as of July 31, 2026. Serving clients for more than 200 years, BMO provides a broad range of personal and commercial banking, wealth management, global markets and investment banking products and services across Canada, the United States, and select markets globally. BMO is innovating for business value, by deploying and integrating human, digital and artificial intelligence to personalize client experiences, augment teams, and automate its business responsibly. Driven by its purpose, to Boldly Grow the Good
in business and life
, BMO is committed to driving positive change in the world, and making progress for a thriving economy, sustainable future, and stronger communities.
